notice.heading: Saturday 3rd and Sunday 4th October

works_segments.quote: Due to engineering works between Dun Laoghaire and Wicklow on Saturday 3rd and Sunday 4th October.

effects.quote: There will be no DART service between Dun Laoghaire and Greystones.
The following DART stations will be closed: Sandycove and Glasthule / Glenagerary / Dalkey / Killiney / Shankill / Woodbrook / Shankill / Bray / Greystones and Kilcoole

notice.detail:
Due to engineering works between Dun Laoghaire and Wicklow on Saturday 3rd and Sunday 4th October.
There will be no DART service between Dun Laoghaire and Greystones. DART services will operate between Malahide / Howth / Dun Laoghaire stations only.
The following DART stations will be closed: Sandycove and Glasthule / Glenagerary / Dalkey / Killiney / Shankill / Woodbrook / Shankill / Bray / Greystones and Kilcoole
The Leap card used on Iarnród Éireann services can be used on all TFI public transport services in the affected area.
